content.text: The eval process tree survived the stop, so I'm killing it, then cleaning up the worktree it was using.

input.command: taskkill //PID 19324 //T //F 2>&1 | tail -3; taskkill //PID 8060 //T //F 2>&1 | tail -3; S="C:/Users/shrey/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-shrey-Desktop-Elemental-harness/48fd0b89-0bb7-4d72-841b-60770e4d02b7/scratchpad"; powershell -NoProfile -Command "@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | ? { \$_.CommandLine -match 'run-eval|dsh-eval-' -and \$_.Name -notmatch 'powershell|bash' }).Count"; for w in $(git -C "$S/upstream" worktree list --porcelain | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | grep dsh-eval); do git -C "$S/upstream" worktree remove --force "$w" && echo "removed $w"; done; git -C "$S/upstream" worktree prune; git -C "$S/upstream" worktree list
input.description: Kill eval process tree and remove its worktrees
